## [from PROJECT.md] Toolkit promotion changelog (apply to the shared toolkit at wrap-up — do NOT edit it mid-build)

**This table IS the future changelog for the shared toolkit** at `~/Mendix/mxcli-project-toolkit`.
Each row is an intended, reviewed promotion to apply later (wrap-up, or a deliberate session) — the
shared toolkit stays untouched until then, so other projects' sessions never read half-baked edits.
Each row names the exact target file + placement so it's directly actionable. Per conversion-runbook.md
Wrap-up rule: *"Every point where the pipeline's silence forced an improvised decision is a runbook
defect — fix it in this file or the relevant stage skill."* (Deadline is 2026-07-27; these are
post-build, not blockers.)

| # | Defect | Where it bit us | Proposed fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| TD-01 | Stage-3 `architecture-blueprint.md` produces a wiring *diagram* but does not mandate a **build-consumable dependency inventory** — a versioned marketplace-module list + a complete internal element dependency graph with "must-exist-before" ordering hints. | Workflow Commons (a CONFIRMED marketplace import) was missing from the blueprint; no marketplace versions were pinned anywhere; the build plan had to re-derive the dependency graph. Surfaced 2026-07-21 at the Stage 3→4 boundary. | Add a required "Dependency Inventory" deliverable to the Stage-3 skill (versioned marketplace list + internal call graph), gated by gate-check. For THIS project it's absorbed into build-plan §0. |
| TD-02 | No skill/STOP-table entry told us the local `./mxcli` binary could be stale and missing whole feature grammars (workflow). Led to an incorrect "workflow is Studio-Pro-GUI-only" conclusion. | 2026-07-21: local "dev" build lacked `CREATE WORKFLOW`; only found by testing. | Add a session-start / preflight check that records `./mxcli --version` and flags when it's a non-release "dev" build or behind the latest upstream release, so capability gaps are caught before they shape an architecture decision. |
| TD-04 | No named "mid-build change loop" for requirements that surface during Stage 5, and no explicit source-of-truth / verify-not-assert guardrail. Pipeline is forward (P→7); mid-build requirement injection + cross-session regression are unaddressed. | 2026-07-21: user asked for guardrails to keep consistent output with minimal drift/regression as new requirements surface during dev. | **Source (proven here):** CLAUDE.local.md "Anti-drift guardrails & mid-build change loop" section. **Apply to toolkit as (placement researched 2026-07-21):** (a) **Source-of-truth order + verify-not-assert** → new short principle subsection in `conversion-runbook.md` near §1 (Interview Protocol) — it's cross-cutting, governs every gate; cross-link `query-the-model.md`. (b) **Mid-build change loop** (capture→classify→route→cascade→re-gate) → `iterative-build-loop.md`, as a section **immediately after** "Requirements Drift-Sync Rule" (the change loop is the superset; drift-sync is its BRD-sync step). (c) **build-plan §9 as living regression ledger** → one line in `brd-to-build-plan.md` §9 + a re-verify item in `iterative-build-loop.md`'s per-phase gate. Note: runbook §3b ("Requirements drift-sync") already exists — reference it, don't recreate. |
| TD-05 | Stage 4 produced only a markdown build plan — no human-viewable HTML render, and no project-wide artifact hub. Other Stage-3/4 artifacts (blueprint, workflow) had HTML companions, but the build plan didn't, and nothing linked all artifacts together. | 2026-07-22: user asked whether the build plan was summarized in HTML and whether all artifacts (arch defs, HTML, design system, wireframes) were wired together. | **Done for this project + promoted to toolkit:** added `build-plan.html` as a required Stage-4 deliverable in `brd-to-build-plan.md` "Output" item 10 + the `architect-agent` def (render beside the md, regenerate on status change). Also added `project-hub.html` (artifact index). **Future toolkit work:** consider auto-generating the hub + HTML renders from `gate-check.sh` so every project gets one. |
| TD-06 | No lifecycle marker for a *completed* MDL script — nothing distinguishes "written" from "executed + mxbuild-clean + tested". Working folder can't show what's left to build. | 2026-07-22: user asked to store completed MDL under a DONE marker + add the rule to the pipeline. | **Added to `iterative-build-loop.md` "Gate step 5 — mark the script DONE":** on full-gate pass, `git mv mdlsource/<NN-name>.mdl mdlsource/done-<NN-name>.mdl` (filename prefix, NOT a subfolder — user preference) in the same commit as the phase gate. `<name>.mdl` = pending; `done-<name>.mdl` = done+tested. Applies to THIS project from Phase 1 onward. |
| TD-03 | Data sourcing is not a crisp early gate — it's scattered across Stage 1 (sources), Stage 3 (⑤ volumes / ⑥ integration contracts), Stage 7 (migration), and is migration-centric. For greenfield / requirements-driven builds there's no single place that forces a per-source disposition. | 2026-07-21: user (rightly) asked late whether data migration / Excel / exports / APIs mattered — the pipeline never posed it as one explicit question. | Add a "Data Sourcing Matrix" gate (Stage 1 or early Stage 3): for each data entity, force migrated / seeded / stubbed / live-API / user-entered + format + import/export need. Applies to all entry modes, not just migration. |
